title: Tiny, cute backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Straps -->
  <path d='M30 30 Q30 18 42 18' stroke='#e05a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 30 Q70 18 58 18' stroke='#e05a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Main body -->
  <rect x='22' y='28' width='56' height='54' rx='14' fill='#3aa0e0'/>
  <!-- Body shading -->
  <path d='M22 66 Q22 82 36 82 L64 82 Q78 82 78 66 L78 60 Q78 74 64 74 L36 74 Q22 74 22 60 Z' fill='#2a7fb8'/>
  <!-- Top flap -->
  <path d='M26 30 Q50 18 74 30 L74 40 Q50 30 26 40 Z' fill='#5cc0f5'/>
  <!-- Flap highlight -->
  <path d='M30 32 Q50 22 70 32' stroke='#a8e2ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front pocket -->
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='32' height='24' rx='8' fill='#5cc0f5'/>
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='32' height='24' rx='8' fill='none' stroke='#a8e2ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Pocket zipper -->
  <path d='M36 60 L64 60' stroke='#2a7fb8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Zipper pull -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <!-- Buckles -->
  <rect x='34' y='40' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='40' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M44 22 Q50 14 56 22' stroke='#ffd23a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
